'''Spaceport Customs''' was a small, dingy office building located close to [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was only used when customs officers had to leave the [[Spaceport Traffic Control/Legends|Mos Eisley Spaceport Control Tower]] to work in the inner sections of the city.<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
